title: From Showgirls to Performers: Fine-tuning with Gender-inclusive Language for Bias Reduction in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the likelihood of generating stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences using the gender dimension of the CrowS-Pairs benchmark, measuring perplexity differences for sentences with female/male target terms using the RedditBias benchmark, and assessing the frequency of hurtful language generation for binary gender prompts using the HONEST benchmark.

Measuring perplexity differences for sentences containing queer target terms using the queerness dimension of the RedditBias benchmark, and evaluating the generation of hurtful language in sentence completions for LGBTQ+ terms using the extended HONEST benchmark.
